Galetry is A peaceful gallery resting between the mountain tops. Eager to collect your scrap and deliver it to the company building.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Abandoned.

CONDITIONS: Warm, hilly terrain, supports diverse plantlife.

FAUNA: A healthy ecosystem, fauna rarely exhibits dangerous behaviour.

> Environment

Galetry is a forested and hilly moon. Trees, tall grass, and flowers cover the terrain and a waterfall can be seen behind the ship falling into a small river. The time of day is randomly selected between morning, noon, evening, and rarely night when players land on the moon.

The most prominent feature on Galetry is the large building directly behind the ship, which plays music inside. It houses busts of Hoarding Bugs and a giant art museum of pictures depicting both custom content from Wesley's Moons and vanilla Lethal Company areas, such as Experimentation and Offense. Two smaller buildings can be found to the left and right of the ship respectively, the left being the Fire Exit and the right being the Gift Shop.

Museum's Ambience

Outside Ambience

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside the Building

Immediately left upon entering will be a Log translator for players to log Loggable Items. Additionally, a Videotape player can be found by going left upon entering the building, climbing a ladder on the right-hand side, and climbing the stairs to the right. Videotapes can be inserted into here for players to watch and unlock new moons.

A desk can be found on the right side of the building where players can sell their scrap. Immediately to the right upon entering the building, players can also place items on a counter and press a button to transfer them over to the desk to make transportation of large amounts of scrap easier.

A bust of a Hoarding Bug with a flashlight pointing to another bust can be found on the left side of the building. Interacting with the bust the flashlight is pointing at will cause the stairs to move and reveal a hidden backstage area. Butch, a passive and invulnerable Butler, will appear and start cleaning when players walk through. At the end of the hallway is a sealed door, The great mystery log, and a large apparatus sticking out on the left side. Interacting with this apparatus will turn the lights on. Players can leave this area by backtracking, interacting with a Hoarding Bug bust, and waiting for the stairs to move again.

Additionally, players will find slots to insert three more special apparatus on either side of the sealed door: The Cosmic apparatus, Royal apparatus, and Bloody apparatus. These can be found on Cosmocos, Calist, and Demetrica respectively. Inserting an apparatus will be saved until the player is fired, but inserting all three apparatus will permanently be saved on the save file. Once all three are inserted, the door will open to reveal the Hyx videotape and the Dread log.

Videotapes

Scattered around the museum are a few tapes. There is one for Motra, Infernis, Asteroid-13, and a special tape labeled "???"

Fire Exit

A fire exit can be found to the left after exiting the ship. Inside will be a door to the left that requires a Fabricated key to open, the Intruder log, and a blocked entrance. A Fabricated key can be crafted on Gratar for one Steel, two Copper wiring, and one Rubber.

Fabricator

After opening the door, a fabrication machine similar to the one on Gratar can be found where players can craft Blank floppy discs instead of Untampered operating panels. Players can also still craft Triangulation devices, Double barrel shotguns, Shotgun shells, Adrenaline-stims, Health-stims, Pulatrum spore emitters, Boomboxes, Advanced flashlights, Fog reducers, Radar boosters, Action figures, Weed killer, De-weed, Pesticide sprinklers, Fabricated keys, and Single-barrel shotguns on Galetry. Any Ingredient Items deposited into either machine will be shared between them and resources will save even after players are fired. Note that there is a conversion rate for ingredients to resources (e.g., 1 Steel ingot equals 3 Steel) and these can be found in the Ingredient Items section mentioned above.

Whiteboard

Additionally, a whiteboard can be found in this room that contains a more accurate list of various moons that can spawn each Ingredient Item. The moons underlined in green are surplus moons that both have a higher chance at spawning that specific ingredient and have a chance at spawning larger variants of that ingredient. The exception is Fission-C, which does not currently spawn Large plastic stock.

Image ⁠

Gift Shop

The Gift Shop can be found to the right (north) after exiting the ship. The Quickstart floppy disk and Failsafe floppy disk can be found underneath the counter on the right. The former unlocks Asteroid-13, Infernis, and Motra while the latter will re-unlock any moons that randomly locked themselves again on the save file.

Additionally, you can buy some scrap or even something different like action figures here. You can also buy the Untampered operating panel (Vintage Control Panel) for ▮7000 and Mortor's mortar for ▮9000 here.

NOTE: Scrap has a price multiplier of 4, meaning the price to buy it is four times as much as its value.
Special items and action figures have normal price multiplier (1.0).
Also:

  • Every scrap spot has a 10% chance to be empty.
  • Every action figure spot has a 15% chance to be empty.
  • Mortor's mortar spot has a 20% chance to be empty.
  • Untampered operating panel (Vintage Control Panel) spot has a 33.3% chance to be empty.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Unlocks

Asteroid-13: Asteroid-13 videotape found on the exterior OR log "Quick start floppy disk" found on the exterior.
Motra: Motra videotape found on the exterior OR log "Quick start floppy disk" found on the exterior.
Infernis: Infernis videotape found on the exterior OR log "Quick start floppy disk" found on the exterior.
Crowd: "Teach the disloyal" videotape that is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop.
Dreck: Log "Floppy disk" that is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop.

Hyx: Hyx videotape found on the exterior after inserting the Cosmic, Royal, and Bloody Apparatus into their respective power slots in the backstage area behind the moveable staircase. These apparatus can be found on Cosmocos, Calist, and Demetrica respectively.

> Lore

Collector Logs

These logs can be found around Galetry. In order, The Collector can be found on the Hoarding Bug bust to the right of the Log translator, Company trouble can be found on the ground to the left of the counter, Intruder can be found on the ground past the fire exit door, and The great mystery can be found in the backstage area on some boxes near the secure door. Dread can be found in the room past the secure door.

The Collector

Text ⁠
I cannot say I am much of a writer, I beg of you, don’t have grave expectations.
As for any story it would be good to know who’s behind the pencil. Or keyboard in this instance.

To introduce myself, my name is Zellenah. Born on Haltar under the family name Cross.
For those who are unaware, Haltar is likely one of the wealthiest moons still remaining in our region.
First, an agreement. Then the golden flame. Foolish to have gotten involved.
Our father couldn’t keep the political talk to himself so I’ve become rather educated on the conflict.

I feel I am already losing the path. Where was I? Ah yes.
For the greater part of my life I have spent mindlessly staring at golden halls and sipping the most elegant vintages while relatives endlessly discuss their fortunes with a devotion I could not understand. We’ve always gone on the same trips and visited the same fountains. I couldn’t convey how often I’ve seen the gemstone waters.
You could say I’ve always had more of an explorative trait. The predictability of it all became rather stifling. The people are kind, but perhaps a touch soulless. All they conversed about was their wealth and what grandiose places they visited. I found it to be rather dull. Terribly underwhelming. I fear the normality of it all has greatly impacted my joy of what were seemingly magnificent things.

I found myself unwilling to accept such predictability so I left for a few trips outside of our usual experiences.
A majority of the places I went to were fresh, unique. Often whelming as I had witnessed the same before but on a grander scale.

Then, during one of these visits there were these magnetized pebbles. Not too extraordinary I believe we have all seen magnets before. But these pebbles, when they touched they would brighten up. Not only brighten up, they would share a light that traveled between them. Now that was lovely. I had never seen that before. Truly magnificent. I still have them somewhere I am quite certain. Perhaps in one of my drawers with the crystals which pacifies insects with a soft drone, another magical find.
Either way I put on a glove and took a hand full of them back to the manor.
From then on all I ever wanted was to collect more of these interesting objects.
Indeed I did. I went on many trips following this initial find.
I had gathered plentiful mistiques. It had gotten to a point where they were turning my manors into a dreadful mess.
There was a terrible need for a place to put these things. And that’s when I came with the idea of the gallery. A gallery of uniquities.
I wouldn’t want it to be back on Haltar, you could display something magnificent and they wouldn’t even lift their glasses.

This place looks delightful and happens to be right in the center of everything. Nearly too good to be true.
So I acquired this small moon and began planning out the gallery.
A few months pass and now we are here.

I appreciate your reading. I find it incredibly relaxing to write.
Perhaps I might write some more in the future.

Company Trouble

Text ⁠
I desire to write again following today's frightful ordeal.
It was in the early morning when the trouble began. I had woken up from an annoyingly repetitive beeping coming from my computer. And so I had a gaze at what happened to be a message. It was deeply unsettling.
It read as follows: 
“The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”.
Of course I took this sudden message very dear. It had appeared to be rather important though a bit distasteful. So as with any message of seemingly grave importance like this I had informed them, in terms perhaps less diplomatic than advisable, that I had no interest in their proposal.

Not much time had passed and I heard this charming jingle of an elevator of sorts followed by an explosion. Immediately I put on my gloves and armed myself with an antique blade in hopes it would scare away whoever had impolitely seared my front yard. Or at the very least offer me the confidence to confront them.

To my surprise there was nobody there. Only the wind, a dull quietness and a pod with a big gap presumably from the explosion.
Then to my surprise, a dreadful swarm of hornets attacked me. I ran away as fast as I could and locked myself in my bed chamber.
Then I remembered those droning crystals. Unsure where I had left them I began searching. It had taken me a fair moment but in the end I discovered them to be in a small box in one of my closets. I took out a few and slowly opened the door. Nothing in the hallway. Quite curious. I slowly made my way along the gallery towards the entrance, not a hornet in sight. Then to my surprise there was a bulging man standing in the grass. He quietly gazed at me. To my knowledge I was alone, there hadn’t been any visitors in days. I yelled out to him. No response. Frightening. I took a step back. Then he seemed to search for something in his tailor coat. Before long he ran at me holding a shimmering knife. Having neither a plan or any courage in that moment I instinctively held out the small bag of crystals between us. To my surprise this bloated man seemed enamored by them. Staring soullessly into the bag. Only then it dawned on me, this was not an ordinary man at all, but a deteriorating arrangement of skin and cloth piloted by these hornets. The dreadful smell only confirmed that. Terrifying discovery yet I must admit in a way quite divine.
I had led him to the back room as he followed the bag of crystals. As I had no proper placement for this ominous gentleman, I elected to leave him where he was. I don’t think he minds that much.

Finally I return to my computer only to find it beeping once more. A new message.
“You have received your first and only warning, The celestial body designated [98 Galetry] falls under company territory and is marked for collection. Agree to our terms or leave immediately.”
I was left with a choice and perhaps in an act of fear I agreed.

As long as I help their workers ship the things they found to Gordion without interrupting their work, I should be left alone.
I’m hopeful.

Intruder

Text ⁠
There has been a fair passage of time between now and the previous time I have written.
I had not expected this arrangement would prove so demanding. It feels as though every few days a new ship arrives at my door, not to be enamored by the mystiques of my gallery but rather to dispose of the debris they have gathered.
I have attempted to inquire about their work yet they seem either hesitant to explain or convey that they know as much as I do.
Either way, I have made the wise decision to automate the process of exporting these worthless pieces to Gordion. I cannot imagine taking care of such matters personally without leaving me exhausted.

There has however been one thing I became aware of regarding this mysterious company. They do not take kindly to their employees and demand them work an absurd amount where failure appears to be met with termination in the quite literal sense.
I have always been aware of the cruelty within this region from the tales but I had never imagined it to be this terrible. Not until I met this gentleman of the name Marcus Brad.

I wouldn't say it was the most pleasant of encounters.
This company ship had landed and were doing their own usual business. I on the other hand was altering some of the displays, not quite paying the attention to my surroundings as I likely should have.
Upon turning, I discovered an armed stranger silently standing a few paces behind me, which in honesty I found considerably less pleasant than the display I had been arranging moments earlier. It was quite alarming even and my response was rather lacking. He demanded that I help him with his harrowing situation which, at the time, I wasn’t aware of how bad it was. His suit appeared worn, bloodied with a scorch mark covering the left side of his helmet. An intimidating figure.
I exclaimed I wouldn’t know how and even if I did there would be a chance this mysterious company would return with evil intent.
He appeared serious, slightly frustrated even. Still pointing the weapon in my direction I attempted to politely ask for his name and how I could be of service.
“My name is Marcus.”, he replied. “I have survived this company for at least five weeks now. You wouldn’t believe what they put us through. You need to help me escape them. Sooner or later they will try to kill me again.”. This ominous response left me curious and so I tried to inquire what exactly he meant with, they will try to kill him again. He replied: “We have a quota we have to meet every few days. It keeps getting higher every time we succeed. I don’t believe it stops. It gets higher and higher until it’s impossible to reach. What happens if we don’t meet the quota? We die. The ship enters space and opens the doors sucking us into space to die an excruciating death. I survived this once, only because I could crawl into this airtight space within the ship’s internals before the doors opened and.. Took the others.”.
I was stunned by this news. I confess I initially expected exaggeration.
I could now sense that it wasn’t frustration in his voice but desperation. Perhaps a hint of sadness and dread.
I offered a proposal, if he’s able to find and bring me uniquities or antiquities. I would search for a way of hiding him from and possibly tricking this company. Which he accepted.

Since that eye opening encounter I have had a security system installed at the counter in case somebody deranged comes upon me with malicious intent.
So it appears for now I will be keeping myself busy with devising a plan alongside some other research I have been doing.
I am certain I will write again.

The Great Mystery

Text ⁠
I must write about this. I believe I have acquired all the information that remains.
Back in my early days on Haltar, on the television this advertisement would play. It was an elegant place to visit with stunning environments, yet I’ve never quite discovered where this place is or even what it’s called. I only remember greenery with purplish waters and a soft pink sky. It was extraordinary. But it seems as if it never existed, though I am certain it did.
Throughout my life I have attempted to inquire information of its whereabouts yet nobody seemed to know. I only had rumors to work off of. Some said it was made to disappear due to a chemical accident. Others said it was a hoax entirely, which seemed like a rather dull explanation.

I simply cannot allow the matter to remain unsolved. It has most certainly been removed form every public source of information as nothing has turned up over the many years I have searched for this. But perhaps a physical copy remains in existence somewhere.

I have reached what may generously be described as a plan, the idea fills me with discomfort, though I see no alternative but to attend to it personally. When Marcus returns I will fly out with him in search of what could be one of the only physical copies of this remarkable advertisement. I believe I know where such a copy may still exist.
You will see me return soon.

Dread

Text ⁠
I am uncertain where to begin.
What has occurred was beyond dreadful.
I find myself lacking the vocabulary to describe it.
It has taken me a fair amount of time to even build the courage to leave my bed chamber.
I am frightened. Deeply frightened. It was a mistake. They died because I ran. I watched him cry in fear as I fled like a coward.
These doors will protect me. Opening them would require a considerable source of power. Such sources are rare in today’s day and age. Yet still I fear. There is a sound. I was certain it was my imagination playing tricks on me. I no longer believe that.
It’s drawing nearer. Every day I become more certain of that.
It spoke. I wish it had not. It echoes through my mind. It leaves me without peace.
It’s drawing nearer.
I should never have viewed that tape.
I assure you what I am hearing is real.
That thing was real.
I urge you to stay away. I beg of you.
Let it remain undisturbed.

Vintage Control Panel

Image & Text ⁠
Vintage Control Panel

This rare model is not often found without 3rd party modifications.
There are few other places where these can be found.
Mainly on the moon of -----ia or within the Golden City.

These models are primarily developed on Kahtera and Gratar.
Products made and sold to companies are generally modified to perform specific tasks with the software made only for their required purposes.

This is an older model and might not be suitable for your expectations.

Available for only
7.000 credits

Cursed Videotape

This videotape will always spawn on Galetry and it does not unlock any moon.

> Trivia

Spooky Galetry

When the player's device clock and date is set to October, Galetry will turn spooky for Halloween. Several candles, cobwebs, pumpkins, and skulls will decorate the buildings, some of the lighting in the buildings will turn purple and green, the sky will turn purple, and the waterfall will turn green. The Teach the disloyal videotape will also spawn next to some pumpkins at the top of the staircase near the projector.

Images ⁠

Additionally, the music inside the main building will be reversed and Halloween ambience will play instead of the regular forest ambience.
